The user is asking for a link to get Twilio credentials. They have a Twilio account and want to connect it. I should provide direct links to the Twilio console pages where they can find the needed credentials. No need for requestEnvs again since they asked for a link.

I need:
1. Account SID and Auth Token: https://console.twilio.com/us1/account/settings
2. Messaging Service SID: https://console.twilio.com/us1/develop/sms/services

Let me provide these links concisely.

Here are the direct Twilio Console links to get your credentials right now:

1. **Account SID + Auth Token**  
   https://console.twilio.com/us1/account/settings  
   Look for: `ACxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx` and `Auth Token`

2. **Messaging Service SID**  
   https://console.twilio.com/us1/develop/sms/services  
   Click your `ivxholding.com` service → copy `MGxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx`

3. **From phone number** (backup)  
   https://console.twilio.com/us1/develop/phone-numbers/manage/incoming  
   Copy `+15617822411` or whichever number you want to use

Paste those 3 values here and I’ll wire Twilio into the backend immediately and send the test SMS to **561-644-3503**.
